name: Lima
blurb: Recent online discussions about Lima highlight ongoing travel connections, such as permanent flight routes, alongside reports of severe weather events including record heat and heavy flooding. Visitors frequently share experiences ranging from local dining and historical tours to concerns about hotel safety.

positive: Interesting catacombs tours featuring historical context and Inca warriors
Memorable tasting menus and dining experiences
Engaging photography of neighborhoods like Miraflores and Barranco
negative: Torrential rains causing road and home flooding

quotes.text: Hotels in Lima are just sketchy. Lima is just sketchy ￼
Catacombs in Lima Peru are pretty interesting and the tour explains who the people were and how they helped form Lima. They even had Inca warriors in the catacombs.

Record heat again in Lima,PERU
25.9C yesterday re-broke the record of August highest temperature which was set earlier this month.
September is expected to have every record pulverized.
The tasting menu, paired with wine, at Maido in Lima, Peru. I still look at the pictures I took. This dish had freeze dried corn that evaporated on your tongue when you took a bite.
